# Fastyy **DEPRECATED**

## A lightweight performance based modpack

again ty for being on this journey with me

For a long time I have personally wanted an actual lightweight modpack that is focused on performance.
So instead of relying on other modpack makers, I made my own.


It comes with great performance mods that are built to give you a great experience while also giving you a basic QOL (quality of life) mods, if you want to disable them I'll say what mods and how to disable them at the end.

Most important mods are:
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), gives a big performance boost and does many things
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), optimized the game's math
- [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations), does a lot of micro optimizations, that adds up to a lot of performance

And a lot more which I can't say because it will be too long.

I have not made any of these mods but I do love them and appreciate the mod makers.

### QOL mods included:
- Gamma Utils (Fullbright)
- Zoomify (Zoom)
- ViaFabricPlus (Join older servers)
- Cubes Without Borders (borderless fullscreen, a must have)

To disable them: either disable through your launcher or add `.disabled` to the mod’s filename.

*Sadly there are no configs included (because im not smart enough to make them) but it only takes a few minutes to get up and running.
